title: devx-sdk-daily-scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - SDK docs / tutorials (working notes)

2026-02-21 - quick brain dump

What's up: small triage of SDK docs issues after pairing with Olivia on the getting-started flow. Several tiny friction points that keep coming up in onboarding sessions.

Top priorities (short):
- README: Clarify auth/ENV var examples (current example shows API_KEY but our client lib expects REDWOOD_API_KEY). Users hit 401 and get confused. -> patch README + quick example snippet.
- Quickstart tutorial: sample app uses old streaming example (callback style). Update to new async streaming iterator and show both Node + Python minimal snippets.
- Sample app (nextjs demo): runtime error when using window global in SSR page (line ~42). Add note: wrap in useEffect or detect window. Maybe ship small fix in demo.
- Code samples: unify param names (model vs model_name) across guides. Search/replace? but be careful with code blocks.
- Console screenshots in tutorial are outdated (new rollout UI). Need fresh screenshots or use generic text instead.

TODO list (actionable):
- [ ] Update README auth snippet (S). Patch branch: feature/readme-auth-fix -> PR to create. tag: quick-win. (assign: me)
- [ ] Replace streaming snippet in quickstart with async iterator example + mention fallback to callback style (assign: Devon)
- [ ] Fix nextjs sample app SSR bug: add useEffect guard, add note in README of sample app (assign: Olivia)
- [ ] Run grep for "model_name" vs "model" across sdk docs -> create list of occurrences and standardize to "model" where possible (assign: Evan)
- [ ] Update console screenshots: schedule short session with product to capture new UI (blocking: product-ops approval)
- [ ] Add a tiny tasks section in quickstart for "common errors" (401, rate limit, invalid model) - include snippet of cURL + expected response codes

Acceptance criteria for each item (notes):
- README auth snippet: clear example for Linux/Mac, Windows Powershell; mention KMS env var naming convention; tests: quickstart runs locally with instructions.
- Streaming snippet: samples for Node (ESM) and Python (async for), short explanation of backpressure/latency tradeoffs.
- Sample app: demo builds in Vercel preview (or locally) without runtime error; add CI step to run a lightweight smoke test (node 18, next build).

Open questions / notes to self:
- Do we want to deprecate callback streaming entirely? probably keep for a while but mark as legacy in a note.
- Should code snippets live in a single canonical repo folder (fragments) and be pulled into docs (sphinx / mdx import)? That would remove drift. Worth a short RFC.
- Consider adding a tiny "known pitfalls" page for Dedicated/Private customers (common misconfigs: VPC egress, model pin mismatch). Might be a separate doc owned by dedicated/private docs.

Links & refs I checked today:
- GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/issues/342 (streaming example mismatch)
- Linear: DX-128 for quickstart fixes
- Demo repo: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-nextjs-demo (clone locally to reproduce SSR bug)

Notes from pairing session with Olivia (2026-02-20):
- People expect "one click" run in quickstart; current steps require manual env var set which confuses. Idea: add tiny "run in terminal" script that sets temp env and runs example (explicitly note not for prod).
- Keep samples under 30 LOC where possible. If >30, move to sample-app and link out.

Quick patch plan (this afternoon):
1) Create branch feature/readme-auth-fix, update README with correct REDWOOD_API_KEY variable, add small note on rotating keys. -> 30 min.
2) Draft streaming snippet update and post to GH issue for review (Devon) -> 45 min.
3) Open PR for nextjs sample fix (Olivia to review) -> aim to merge EOD.

Misc scribbles:
- Short-term: prioritize fixes that unblock >2 users in last week (401, streaming mismatches, SSR bug).
- Medium-term: prototype snippet-import pipeline to avoid drift between repo code and docs. Might be part of docs infra epic.

TODO: add checklist to PR template to remind writers to update screenshots when UI changes.

----
Raw quick examples to include in patches (copy to PR):
Node (async streaming):
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({model: 'rwd-1', input: 'hello', stream: true});
for await (const part of res.stream()) { console.log(part.delta); }

Python (async streaming):
async for chunk in await client.chat.completions.stream(model='rwd-1', input='hello'):
    print(chunk.delta)

(These will need syntax highlighting and minor edits before final commit)

End scratchpad.

-- Samantha
